name: Scalpel "Permafrost" Sniper Rifle
description: The Scalpel is a unique and versatile sniper rifle from Kastak Arms. Designed with a vertical two barrel configuration, it has two fire modes so you can adapt your shot to the situation to deliver a single, powerful shot from a long distance, or fire both barrels in quick succession to create a double-shot burst. This special Permafrost edition features blue and grey coloring reminiscent of a glacier under a blinding winter sky.
